up: Retrieve the canonical SMILES, ChEMBL ID, name, maximum phase, and molecule type for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL5375941. Order the results by ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS name, md.max_phase AS max_phase, md.molecule_type AS type, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5375941' ORDER BY chembl_id
